description: Fetches a site's security.txt from /.well-known/security.txt (fallback /security.txt) and parses the RFC 9116 fields: contacts, expiry (and whether it has expired), encryption, policy, acknowledgments, languages, canonical, hiring. Reports whether it is PGP-signed and lists RFC problems found. Public http(s) hosts only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site (any page; only the host is used)

name: web_security_txt
title: Web Security Txt
